faq_heading: Homes near R E Mountain Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the R E Mountain Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the R E Mountain Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names R E Mountain Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to R E Mountain Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Peter Ewart Middle School (0.3 km north), Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (0.8 km north-east) and R C Garnett Demonstration Elementary (1.1 km south).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of R E Mountain Secondary

15 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of R E Mountain Secondary in a straight line (12 elementary, 2 middle, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Peter Ewart Middle School, 0.3 km away, and the farthest on this list is Dorothy Peacock Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is Crescent Heights Academy (2.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Alex Hope Elementary (2.6 km).
